title: 23.37. Ajjhattattika, Kusalattika
note: Pāli only: every English translation of the Abhidhamma is still under copyright, so no English can be shown yet. A free translation will be added if one becomes available.

verses.t: Naajjhattaṁ nakusalaṁ dhammaṁ paccayā bahiddhā kusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. Nabahiddhā nakusalaṁ dhammaṁ paccayā ajjhatto kusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. (Saṅkhittaṁ.) Hetuyā dve …pe… avigate dve.

Naajjhattaṁ naakusalaṁ dhammaṁ paccayā bahiddhā akusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. Nabahiddhā naakusalaṁ dhammaṁ paccayā ajjhatto akusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. (Saṅkhittaṁ.) Hetuyā dve …pe… avigate dve.

Naajjhattaṁ naabyākataṁ dhammaṁ paṭicca bahiddhā abyākato dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. Nabahiddhā naabyākataṁ dhammaṁ paṭicca ajjhatto abyākato dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. (Saṅkhittaṁ.) Hetuyā dve, adhipatiyā dve …pe… avigate dve.
